segments.thag5.12:1.1: “Yo ve garūnaṃ vacanaññu dhīro, vase ca tamhi janayetha pemaṃ;
segments.thag5.12:1.3: So bhattimā nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.
segments.thag5.12:2.3: So thāmavā nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.
segments.thag5.12:3.1: “Yo ve samuddova ṭhito anejo, gambhīrapañño nipuṇatthadassī;
segments.thag5.12:3.3: Asaṃhāriyo nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.
segments.thag5.12:4.1: “Bahussuto dhammadharo ca hoti, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī;
segments.thag5.12:4.3: So tādiso nāma ca hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assa.
segments.thag5.12:5.1: “Atthañca yo jānāti bhāsitassa, atthañca ñatvāna tathā karoti;
segments.thag5.12:5.3: Atthantaro nāma sa hoti paṇḍito, ñatvā ca dhammesu visesi assā”ti.
segments.thag5.12:7.3: Saṭṭhi ca pañca gāthāyo, therā ca ettha dvādasāti.
